panicked.name: Panicked
panicked.desc: Shaken after a nearby ally fell — -3 DEF and -25% accuracy for 2 turns.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.desc: -5 DEF & RES — armor and wards shattered.

sleep.name: Asleep
sleep.desc: Skips turn; 35% chance to wake each turn

confusion.name: Confused
confusion.desc: 33% chance to hit self when attacking

paralysis.name: Paralyzed
paralysis.desc: -1 SPD (movement / attack range / accuracy); 25% chance to skip each action

dispel.name: Dispelled
dispel.desc: Cannot use moves that cost energy

assisted.name: Assisted
assisted.desc: +6 ATK and +6 MAG for the next strike

spectralHaze.name: Spectral Haze
spectralHaze.desc: 👻 Haunted by ghostly fog — every attack this unit makes MISSES until it clears.

protected.name: Protected
protected.desc: Immune to all damage and effects until next turn

countering.name: Countering
countering.desc: Blocks the next enemy attack and counters back

ambushGuard1.name: Ambush Guard
ambushGuard1.desc: Watching (range 1) — reaction-strikes the first enemy that moves adjacent this enemy turn.

ambushGuard3.name: Ambush Guard
ambushGuard3.desc: Watching (range 3) — reaction-strikes the first enemy that moves within 3 tiles this enemy turn.

rage.name: Raged
rage.desc: Must attack the nearest enemy; can only use attack moves (+3 ATK, -2 DEF)

infected.name: Infected
infected.desc: All stats reduced by 50% — ATK / MAG / DEF / RES / SPD halved

happy.name: Happy
happy.desc: Cannot attack the unit that applied this status (3 turns by default)

followLead.name: Following
followLead.desc: Can only move toward the unit that applied this status. Cannot attack anyone (1-3 turns)

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.desc: +3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES while blessed.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.desc: -3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES while cursed.

mirror.name: Phantom Veil
mirror.desc: Illusory duplicates flicker around the unit — 50% chance to dodge any incoming attack.

toxic.name: Necrotic Bloom
toxic.desc: A necrotic infection that worsens — 3 dmg/turn × turns active (3, 6, 9, 12…). Cleanse to stop the spiral.

doom.name: Mortal Sentence
doom.desc: A death sentence with a countdown — when the timer expires, this unit dies. Cleanse to dispel.

reraise.name: Soul Anchor
reraise.desc: A tether to the living world — revives at 50% max HP the first time this unit would be KO'd.

moxie.name: Killer Instinct
moxie.desc: Each stack grants +2 ATK. Stacks build on KO; capped at 5 stacks (+10 ATK).

knockdown.name: Knocked Down
knockdown.desc: Shoved off balance and knocked prone — skips their next turn.

offBalance.name: Off-Balance
offBalance.desc: Stumbling from the impact — -2 movement/range and -2 DEF.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.desc: Shoves the hit target AWAY from the attacker. Status Duration = tiles pushed (1-4); Status Chance = proc %.

grappleHook.name: Grappling Hook
grappleHook.desc: Yanks the hit target TOWARD the attacker. Status Duration = tiles pulled (1-4); Status Chance = proc %.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.desc: A worsening wound — 2 dmg/turn × turns active (2, 4, 6…). Cleanse to stop it.

electrified.name: Electrified
electrified.desc: Crackling current — 1-3 dmg/turn and 30% chance to fumble each action.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.desc: Encased in stone — cannot act, but +8 DEF & RES.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.desc: Cannot see — 40% chance to fumble each action and -2 ATK.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.desc: -6 MAG and -3 RES — arcane channels fouled.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: Blind fury — must attack the nearest enemy; +6 ATK, -5 DEF.

entangled.name: Entangled
entangled.desc: Bound by roots/webbing — cannot act until it breaks.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.desc: Head ringing — 30% chance to fumble each action and -1 movement.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.desc: Fortune shields the unit — 30% chance to dodge any incoming attack.

reborn.name: Reborn
reborn.desc: Recently returned to the battlefield from death.

burningRes.name: Burning Resurrection
burningRes.desc: Risen in flame — +4 ATK & +4 MAG while it burns.

soulFlame.name: Soul Flame
soulFlame.desc: Wreathed in soul-fire — +4 DEF & +4 RES while it lasts.

frostForm.name: Frost Form
frostForm.desc: Encased in frost: +4 DEF, +3 RES, -1 SPD. Fades after a few turns.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.desc: Heal 2 HP at start of your turn

catalyst.name: Catalyst (Lesser)
catalyst.desc: 🜂 Holds Primordial Energy — can initiate an Archon Summon, summoning Lesser Archons.

catalystAscended.name: Ascended Catalyst
catalystAscended.desc: 🜂 Can initiate an Archon Summon, summoning up to Greater Archons.

catalystDivine.name: Divine Catalyst
catalystDivine.desc: 🜂 Can initiate an Archon Summon, summoning up to Divine Archons.

catalystPrimordial.name: Primordial Catalyst
catalystPrimordial.desc: 🜂 Can initiate an Archon Summon, summoning up to Creator Avatars & Primordial-class entities.

kalonSuppress.name: Null Awakening
kalonSuppress.desc: 🚫 While this unit lives, NEITHER player can Kalon Transform.

archonSuppress.name: Seal the Source
archonSuppress.desc: 🚫 While this unit lives, NEITHER player can perform an Archon Summon.

raiseFromDead.name: Raise From Dead
raiseFromDead.desc: On death: leave a glowing tombstone for 2 turns. If the tile stays clear, the unit rises at 60% HP. (1-3 charges per unit.)

forcedAscension.name: Forced Ascension
forcedAscension.desc: 🜂 Automatically Kalon-transforms at the configured timing (start of its own turn by default) — no charge spent. Configure in the Forge.

rebirthShift.name: Rebirth Shift
rebirthShift.desc: 🜁 When this unit dies, at the start of its owner's next turn it returns as a unit from its admin-defined Rebirth Pool (summoning sick, no inherited buffs unless allowed).

phoenixRebirth.name: Phoenix Rebirth Aura
phoenixRebirth.desc: 🔥 When an allied unit dies within this unit's aura, a % chance (default 30%) to revive it at a % HP (default 25%). Configure range / chance / limits in the Forge.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: Once per match, redirects the first incoming attack on any ally within 2 tiles to this unit instead. Consumed after use.

inspire.name: Inspire
inspire.desc: When an allied unit enters play whose cost ≥ this unit's cost, that unit gains the configured Inspire Effect (Swift / stat buff / buff-all-stats / draw / energy). Buff All Stats requires the new unit to cost strictly MORE.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.desc: Heal 5 HP after killing a unit

sunbather.name: Sunbather
sunbather.desc: Heal 4 HP at start of turn during ☀️ Sunny weather

dustcloak.name: Dustcloak
dustcloak.desc: Immune to 🏜️ Sandstorm; +1 SPD in Sandstorm

weatherweaver.name: Weatherweaver
weatherweaver.desc: Your weather cards last 2 extra turns

weatherSummoner.name: Weather Summoner
weatherSummoner.desc: When summoned from hand, calls weather matching this unit's primary element (4 turns).

energySpring.name: Energy Spring
energySpring.desc: +1 energy at the start of your turn while this unit is on the field.

kalonChannel.name: Kalon Channel
kalonChannel.desc: When this unit KOs an enemy, refunds 1 Kalon use to your pool (cap 3).

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Enemies in range must attack this unit before any other target.

frostForm.name: Frost Form
frostForm.desc: Once per battle: when this unit would be KO'd by non-ice damage, survive at 1 HP and gain Frost Form status for 3 turns (more DEF/RES, less SPD).

consume.name: Consume
consume.desc: When this unit KOs an enemy, absorb their ATK and DEF (+1 each per kill, capped at +5 total stacks).

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: Enters play with no summoning sickness — can move and attack immediately on the turn it is deployed.

swiftstrike.name: Swiftstrike
swiftstrike.desc: Attacks land before the target can counter. Strips the Countering stance on hit. If the target is killed, Lethal Retribution is also silenced.

crush.name: Crush
crush.desc: Excess damage from a killing blow carries over to the enemy hero. If this unit kills with 4 overkill, the hero takes 4 damage.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: Does not exhaust on its first attack each turn — can attack a second time. The bonus resets every turn.

spellshield.name: Spellshield
spellshield.desc: Cannot be targeted by opponent on-play AoE effects or consumables. Board-wipes and direct attacks still resolve normally.

lethal.name: Lethal
lethal.desc: Any damage this unit deals to a non-hero unit is instantly fatal, regardless of remaining HP.

defender.name: Defender
defender.desc: This unit cannot attack. It holds the line as a defensive blocker and cannot be directed to strike.

unblockable.name: Unblockable
unblockable.desc: Ignores Bodyguard and Guardian intercepts. Can hit flying units without needing aerial reach.

attackRage.name: Attack Rage
attackRage.desc: Each time this unit attacks, it permanently gains +1 ATK (or +N if rageN is set on the card). Stacks every swing.

mobilize.name: Mobilize
mobilize.desc: Costs 2 less energy to play when at least 1 allied non-hero unit is already on the battlefield.

prophecy.name: Prophecy
prophecy.desc: When this unit enters play, your next deployed unit gains +2 ATK and +2 DEF.

lifedrain.name: Lifedrain
lifedrain.desc: Heals this unit for HP equal to all combat damage it deals — full 1:1 drain (stronger than the 30% Lifesteal passive).

skyguard.name: Skyguard
skyguard.desc: This unit can target and hit flying units with any attack, regardless of move type or range. Anti-air specialist.

invincible.name: Invincible
invincible.desc: Cannot be destroyed by damage. Every attack, spell, or DoT that would reduce HP to 0 stops at 1 HP instead. Removal effects still work.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Steps in front of attacks targeting allies within 1 tile. Redirects enemy hits to this unit instead. No use limit.

physicalImmortal.name: Unbreakable Body
physicalImmortal.desc: 🛡️ Cannot die from PHYSICAL damage — drops to 1 HP instead. Magical damage kills normally.

magicalImmortal.name: Soul Shield
magicalImmortal.desc: 🔮 Cannot die from MAGICAL damage — drops to 1 HP instead. Physical damage kills normally.

physicalRetribution.name: Spiked Carapace
physicalRetribution.desc: ☠️ When hit by a PHYSICAL attack, the attacker is instantly slain. Enemy heroes are immune.

magicalRetribution.name: Mana Feedback
magicalRetribution.desc: ☠️ When hit by a MAGICAL attack, the attacker is instantly slain. Enemy heroes are immune.

predatorsEye.name: Predator's Eye
predatorsEye.desc: 👁 Reaction: when an enemy moves within 2 tiles, strike them for free. Once per enemy turn.

hairTrigger.name: Hair Trigger
hairTrigger.desc: 🎯 Overwatch + Ambush reactions can crit (default reactions cannot).

coolUnderPressure.name: Cool Under Pressure
coolUnderPressure.desc: 🧊 Overwatch + Ambush reactions ignore the 25% damage penalty — full-power reaction shots.

stabilize.name: Stabilize
stabilize.desc: 🩸 Bleed-Out — When this non-hero unit hits 0 HP, they enter Bleeding for 3 turns instead of dying. Any adjacent ally can Stabilize them (revive to 1 HP). Combat Medkit consumable also revives. Unstabilized after 3 turns → PERMADEATH (removed from your collection).

squadSight.name: Squad Sight
squadSight.desc: 🔭 Attack range extends to any tile a teammate can see (radius 3 around any ally).

ironWill.name: Iron Will
ironWill.desc: 🛡 Immune to Panic. Other panic-resist sources stack into this.

outnumbered.name: Underdog
outnumbered.desc: 🆘 While the enemy controls MORE alive units than you do, THIS card costs 0 energy to play from your hand. Only this card — other cards in your hand keep their normal cost. The discount turns off the instant unit counts equalize.

sturdy.name: Bedrock
sturdy.desc: 🪨 If at full HP, any attack that would KO this unit leaves it at 1 HP instead. Once per battle.

moxie.name: Killer Instinct
moxie.desc: ⚔️ Each KO this unit lands grants +2 ATK permanently (max 5 stacks / +10 ATK).

divineSmite.name: Daybreaker
divineSmite.desc: ✨ The FIRST attack each turn deals +25% damage. Resets each turn-start.

adaptability.name: Elemental Affinity
adaptability.desc: 🔄 Matching-element attacks (STAB) deal +75% damage instead of the normal +50%.

sneakAttack.name: Flanker
sneakAttack.desc: 🗡️ +30% damage on attacks when at least one ALLY is adjacent to the target.

warriorOath.name: Warrior's Oath
warriorOath.desc: +1 ATK per other ally Warrior on the field (max +5)

arcaneBond.name: Arcane Bond
arcaneBond.desc: +1 MAG per other ally Mage on the field (max +5)

packLeader.name: Pack Leader
packLeader.desc: +1 SPD if any other ally Beast is on the field

flockFlight.name: Flock Flight
flockFlight.desc: Becomes Flying while another ally Bird is alive

swarmInstinct.name: Swarm Instinct
swarmInstinct.desc: +10% poison-on-hit chance per other ally Bug (max +30%)

hellbound.name: Hellbound
hellbound.desc: +1 ATK and +1 MAG per other ally Demon (max +4 each)

deathlyVigil.name: Deathly Vigil
deathlyVigil.desc: Heal 2 HP at start of turn per other ally Undead (max 6)

faewish.name: Faewish
faewish.desc: 10% dodge chance per other ally Fairy (max 30%)

dragonsBoon.name: Dragon's Boon
dragonsBoon.desc: +2 ATK and +2 MAG per other ally Dragonkin (max +6 each)

constructed.name: Constructed
constructed.desc: Immune to poison, burn, bleed, and infected

holyAura.name: Holy Aura
holyAura.desc: Heal 1 HP at start of turn per other ally Celestial (max 4)

rootsOfLife.name: Roots of Life
rootsOfLife.desc: Heal 3 HP at start of every turn

coldScales.name: Cold Scales
coldScales.desc: +2 DEF and +2 RES per other ally Reptile (max +6 each); immune to slow and frozen

xenoBond.name: Xeno Bond
xenoBond.desc: Immune to Infected; 25% chance to Infect targets on hit (3t)

geomancer.name: Geomancer
geomancer.desc: 20% chance/turn to destroy the opponent's active Location field

trapHunter.name: Trap Hunter
trapHunter.desc: 🪤 +2 ATK and +1 SPD while ANY trap is on the field (yours OR theirs). The unit thrives when the board is dangerous.

trapDog.name: Trap Dog
trapDog.desc: 🐕 On entering play: reveals every enemy trap on the board for the rest of the match.

trapBreaker.name: Trap Breaker
trapBreaker.desc: 🔧 At the start of your turn: disarms one adjacent enemy trap (random pick from those in Chebyshev radius 1).

wallBreaker.name: Wall Breaker
wallBreaker.desc: 🧱 +50% damage to walls/structures (any wall tile attacked).

surfaceWalker.name: Surface Walker
surfaceWalker.desc: 🧹 Immune to surface hazards. When this unit moves onto a tile with a surface, that surface is cleared (oil / fire / water / glass / mud).

weatherWarden.name: Weather Warden
weatherWarden.desc: 🌤 Active weather ends 1 turn sooner each round this unit is on the field. Clears calm weather windows.

xrayVision.name: X-Ray Vision
xrayVision.desc: 👁 While this unit is alive: ALL enemy units + heroes are auto-scanned. Their type, faction, element, passives, moves, and full stats are visible.

wardVsWarrior.name: Champion's Bane
wardVsWarrior.desc: 🛡️⚔️ Immune to damage from Warrior attackers.

wardVsMage.name: Spellbreaker
wardVsMage.desc: 🛡️🔮 Immune to damage from Mage attackers.

wardVsRogue.name: Eagle Eye
wardVsRogue.desc: 🛡️🗡️ Immune to damage from Rogue attackers.

wardVsBeast.name: Hunter's Mark
wardVsBeast.desc: 🛡️🐺 Immune to damage from Beast attackers.

wardVsBird.name: Falconer's Net
wardVsBird.desc: 🛡️🦅 Immune to damage from Bird attackers.

wardVsBug.name: Exterminator
wardVsBug.desc: 🛡️🐛 Immune to damage from Bug attackers.

wardVsDemon.name: Sanctified
wardVsDemon.desc: 🛡️😈 Immune to damage from Demon attackers.

wardVsUndead.name: Hallowed Flesh
wardVsUndead.desc: 🛡️💀 Immune to damage from Undead attackers.

wardVsDragon.name: Dragon Slayer
wardVsDragon.desc: 🛡️🐉 Immune to damage from Dragonkin attackers.

wardVsConstruct.name: Rust Touch
wardVsConstruct.desc: 🛡️🤖 Immune to damage from Construct attackers.

wardVsCelestial.name: Heretic's Armor
wardVsCelestial.desc: 🛡️😇 Immune to damage from Celestial attackers.

wardVsGoblinoid.name: Tribal Defense
wardVsGoblinoid.desc: 🛡️👺 Immune to damage from Goblinoid attackers.

wardVsFairy.name: Cold Iron
wardVsFairy.desc: 🛡️🧚 Immune to damage from Fairy attackers.

solarFlare.name: Solar Flare
solarFlare.desc: ☀️ Sun: this unit may attack TWICE per turn (first attack each turn is free).

radiantAegis.name: Radiant Aegis
radiantAegis.desc: ☀️ Sun: adjacent allies take 25% less damage (aura).

sunforged.name: Sunforged
sunforged.desc: ☀️ Sun: immune to elemental weakness — super-effective hits are capped at 1× damage.

tideHealer.name: Tide Healer
tideHealer.desc: 🌧️ Rain: heal ALL allied units 2 HP at the start of your turn.

stormChannel.name: Storm Channel
stormChannel.desc: 🌧️ Rain: gain +1 energy at the start of your turn (stacks with other channelers).

sandShroud.name: Sand Shroud
sandShroud.desc: 🏜️ Sandstorm: enemies have +30% miss chance when attacking this unit.

mistDancer.name: Mist Dancer
mistDancer.desc: 🌫️ Mist: your attacks cannot miss, and crit chance +20%.

ambushSoul.name: Ambush Soul
ambushSoul.desc: 🌫️ Mist: the FIRST attack you make each turn deals +50% damage.

eclipseLord.name: Eclipse Lord
eclipseLord.desc: 🌑 Eclipse: +30% damage; attacks ignore 50% of target DEF / RES.

shadowMeld.name: Shadow Meld
shadowMeld.desc: 🌑 Eclipse: ranged attacks (range > 1) automatically miss this unit.

bloodLord.name: Blood Lord
bloodLord.desc: 🩸 Bloodmoon: lifesteal 50% of damage dealt (replaces normal lifesteal in bloodmoon).

crimsonCovenant.name: Crimson Covenant
crimsonCovenant.desc: 🩸 Bloodmoon: adjacent allies gain +2 ATK and +2 MAG (aura).

lucidThinker.name: Lucid Thinker
lucidThinker.desc: 🧠 Mind Realm: your moves cost 1 less energy (min 0).

paradoxGuard.name: Paradox Guard
paradoxGuard.desc: 🌍 Parallel World: your SPD inversion is canceled — keep your normal speed.

tempestSoul.name: Tempest Soul
tempestSoul.desc: 🌪️ Any weather: +2 SPD, +1 ATK, +1 MAG, +1 DEF, +1 RES.

weatherWalker.name: Weather Walker
weatherWalker.desc: 🌪️ Any weather: +1 movement; immune to sandstorm damage and weather-applied status effects.

weatherborn.name: Weatherborn
weatherborn.desc: 🌪️ Any weather: this card costs 0 energy to play (free while any sky is active).

weatherbornRain.name: Weatherborn — Rain
weatherbornRain.desc: 🌧️ Rain only: this card costs 0 energy to play while it is raining.

weatherbornSun.name: Weatherborn — Sun
weatherbornSun.desc: ☀️ Sun only: this card costs 0 energy to play while the sun is out.

weatherbornSand.name: Weatherborn — Sandstorm
weatherbornSand.desc: 🏜️ Sandstorm only: this card costs 0 energy to play during a sandstorm.

weatherbornStorm.name: Weatherborn — Storm
weatherbornStorm.desc: ⚡ Lightning Storm only: this card costs 0 energy to play during a storm.

weatherbornMist.name: Weatherborn — Mist
weatherbornMist.desc: 🌫️ Mist only: this card costs 0 energy to play while mist is up.

weatherbornEclipse.name: Weatherborn — Eclipse
weatherbornEclipse.desc: 🌑 Eclipse only: this card costs 0 energy to play during an eclipse.

weatherbornBloodmoon.name: Weatherborn — Bloodmoon
weatherbornBloodmoon.desc: 🌕 Bloodmoon only: this card costs 0 energy to play under a bloodmoon.

weatherbornMind.name: Weatherborn — Mind Realm
weatherbornMind.desc: 🧠 Mind Realm only: this card costs 0 energy to play in the Mind Realm.

weatherbornParallel.name: Weatherborn — Parallel World
weatherbornParallel.desc: 🔮 Parallel World only: this card costs 0 energy to play in a Parallel World.

inspireAtk.name: Inspire ATK
inspireAtk.desc: ✨ When an allied unit that costs STRICTLY MORE than this unit enters play, that ally gains +1 ATK.

inspireDef.name: Inspire DEF
inspireDef.desc: ✨ When an allied unit that costs STRICTLY MORE than this unit enters play, that ally gains +1 DEF.

inspireMag.name: Inspire MAG
inspireMag.desc: ✨ When an allied unit that costs STRICTLY MORE than this unit enters play, that ally gains +1 MAG.

inspireRes.name: Inspire RES
inspireRes.desc: ✨ When an allied unit that costs STRICTLY MORE than this unit enters play, that ally gains +1 RES.

inspireDrawTimer.name: Arcane Tempo
inspireDrawTimer.desc: ✨ While this unit is alive, you draw 1 extra card at the start of every 3rd turn.

bite.name: Savage Maul
bite.desc: Tear into the target with bared teeth (free)

poisonSting.name: Venom Lash
poisonSting.desc: A venom-tipped strike — afflicts the target with Poison.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Hits adjacent units (friend + foe) for 75% damage

whirlwindSlash.name: Whirlwind Slash
whirlwindSlash.desc: Full spin — strike the target and every unit (friend or foe) in the 8 tiles around you (70% splash).

frostNova.name: Frost Nova
frostNova.desc: Erupts in a frost ring — 80% splash to all adjacent units, 80% chance to Slow each.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Massive ground slam — every unit (friend + foe) within 2 tiles takes 60% damage.

pierceLance.name: Pierce Lance
pierceLance.desc: Drive the lance forward — hits the front 2 rows in the same column, friend or foe.

frontalSweep.name: Frontal Sweep
frontalSweep.desc: A sweeping advance — 3 rows of lane damage in front, hitting any unit (or hero) in the path.

dragonsBreath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragonsBreath.desc: Cone of dragonfire — burns 3 rows ahead, 50% Burn chance per victim.

iceShard.name: Frost Splinter
iceShard.desc: Hurls a sliver of ice — chills the target (Slow).

siphonGrasp.name: Siphon Grasp
siphonGrasp.desc: Parasitic tendrils sap 3-6 HP/turn for 4 turns; 50% chance to stun on contact.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: A howling icestorm — 22 dmg in a 2-tile ring (70% splash). 35% chance per victim to be Frozen (skips turn).

iceCoffin.name: Ice Coffin
iceCoffin.desc: Encases the target in ice — 80% chance to Freeze for 2 turns.

frostNail.name: Frost Nail
frostNail.desc: A frigid bolt — 25% Freeze, 70% Slow. Cheap pressure tool.

deathStrike.name: Death Strike
deathStrike.desc: 🪦 A killing blow — 30% accuracy, but if it lands, the target is instantly slain.

graveSong.name: Grave Song
graveSong.desc: 🪦 A ranged dirge that severs the soul — 25% accuracy, instant KO on hit.

harvestSoul.name: Harvest Soul
harvestSoul.desc: 🪦 Rip the soul straight out — 20% accuracy, instant KO + you regain 1 energy. The rarest finisher.

voidPiercer.name: Void Piercer
voidPiercer.desc: 🪦 A void-lance from across the field — 35% accuracy, instant KO. Cannot crit (already lethal).

meditate.name: Inner Reverie
meditate.desc: A moment of stillness — restore 12 HP.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Vanish in a flash of arcane light and reappear on any empty tile on the battlefield.

selfDetonate.name: Self Detonate
selfDetonate.desc: Detonate yourself — 99% max HP damage (100% if hurt). User is KO'd.

webShot.name: Web Shot
webShot.desc: Sticky ranged web — locks the target down with Slow (3t).

miredCurse.name: Mired Curse
miredCurse.desc: Curse drags the target down — Slow (3t) AND SPD -1 stage.

helpingHand.name: Lend Aid
helpingHand.desc: Brace an ally — their next strike is +6 ATK / +6 MAG.

rallyingCheer.name: Rallying Cheer
rallyingCheer.desc: All allies +6 ATK / +6 MAG next strike.

sharpen.name: Hone Edge
sharpen.desc: Sharpen an ally's blade — +6 ATK / +6 MAG for next strike.

tripStrike.name: Trip Strike
tripStrike.desc: Sweep their legs — 50% chance to stumble (skip their next turn).

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: A deafening crack — 40% chance to stumble.

shoulderCharge.name: Shoulder Charge
shoulderCharge.desc: Plow forward — 30% chance to stumble the target.

solarBeam.name: Sunfire Lance
solarBeam.desc: Gather solar fire for a turn, then unleash a lancing pillar of flame. Fires instantly under ☀️ Sun.

meteorCharge.name: Meteor Charge
meteorCharge.desc: Gather cosmic fire — releases next turn for huge damage.

shadowPulse.name: Umbral Lance
shadowPulse.desc: Tether a strand of darkness, then loose it at range.

flyStrike.name: Sky Dive
flyStrike.desc: Soar out of reach for a turn — untargetable while aloft — then dive-bomb the target.

flyStorm.name: Storm Wing
flyStorm.desc: Ride the gale skyward (untargetable), then call down a thunderous dive.

digStrike.name: Burrow Fang
digStrike.desc: Burrow underground for a turn — untargetable — then erupt beneath the target.

digQuake.name: Geomancy
digQuake.desc: Sink into the stone (untargetable), then rupture the earth under the target.

realmStrike.name: Rift Step
realmStrike.desc: Phase into the rift between realms (untargetable), then tear back into reality on the target.

realmWarp.name: Void Lance
realmWarp.desc: Slip into the void (untargetable), then lance back through with arcane force.

softBoil.name: Soft-Boil
softBoil.desc: Heal an ally for 50% of their max HP.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: Heal 25% max HP. Doubled under ☀️ Sun.

roost.name: Roost
roost.desc: Land and recover — heal 40% max HP.

setSnare.name: Set Snare
setSnare.desc: Lay a Snare trap on your tile.

laySpikes.name: Lay Spikes
laySpikes.desc: Plant a Spike Trap (15 dmg) on your tile.

layInferno.name: Inferno Mine
layInferno.desc: Plant a Flame Burst trap (25 dmg + burn) on your tile.

protect.name: Bulwark Stance
protect.desc: Brace behind an unbreakable guard — immune to all damage and effects until your next turn.

tailWhip.name: Sweeping Lash
tailWhip.desc: A low sweeping strike rattles the target's guard — DEF -1 stage.

leer.name: Withering Gaze
leer.desc: A cold stare cracks their resolve — DEF -1 stage from range.

growl.name: Wolf's Snarl
growl.desc: A primal snarl shakes the target's nerve — ATK -1 stage.

scaryFace.name: Dread Visage
scaryFace.desc: Terror unmasked — SPD -1 stage and 60% chance to Slow.

swordDance.name: Whirlwind Drill
swordDance.desc: A practiced blade routine builds momentum — ATK +2 stages.

ironDefense.name: Iron Vow
ironDefense.desc: Steel the body with an unbreakable oath — DEF +2 stages.

calmMind.name: Inner Sanctum
calmMind.desc: Retreat into the mind's sanctum — MAG and RES +1 stage each.

agility.name: Quicken Step
agility.desc: Sharpen your footwork — SPD +1 stage and grants Haste.

gust.name: Cyclone Push
gust.desc: A spiraling column of wind — 18 dmg and hurls the target 2 tiles back.

airSlash.name: Razor Wind
airSlash.desc: A scything blade of compressed air — 24 dmg, knocks 1 back, 25% Stumble.

shockwave.name: Quake Stomp
shockwave.desc: Slam the earth — 22 dmg and the shockwave throws the target 2 tiles back.

hydroJet.name: Tidal Spear
hydroJet.desc: A lance of pressurized water — 26 dmg, drives 1 tile back.

harpoonYank.name: Harpoon Yank
harpoonYank.desc: Fire a barbed harpoon — 22 dmg and reels the target 2 tiles toward you.

gravityWell.name: Gravity Well
gravityWell.desc: Collapse space around the foe — 15 dmg, drags them 3 tiles closer, 60% Slow.

vineSnare.name: Vine Snare
vineSnare.desc: Lash out with a creeping vine — 16 dmg, yanks the target 1 tile in, 50% Stumble.

oilSlick.name: Oil Slick
oilSlick.desc: Hurl a burst flask — 8 dmg and coats a 3×3 area in flammable Oil (Slows units; ignites under fire).

emberToss.name: Ember Toss
emberToss.desc: Lob a burning coal — 16 dmg and leaves Fire on the tile. Ignites any Oil it lands on.

tidePool.name: Tide Pool
tidePool.desc: Splash a 3×3 area with conductive Water — 12 dmg. A storm attack electrifies the whole pool.

hypnosis.name: Dreamspell
hypnosis.desc: Weave a sleeping enchantment — 70% chance to plunge the target into slumber for 3 turns.

lullaby.name: Dirge of Slumber
lullaby.desc: A haunting melody — 40% chance to lull every enemy in range into sleep.

confuseRay.name: Mind Splinter
confuseRay.desc: Drive a shard of madness into their thoughts — Confuses the target.

counterStance.name: Parry Guard
counterStance.desc: Settle into a parry stance — blocks the next enemy attack and ripostes for 80% of your offense.

riposte.name: Iron Riposte
riposte.desc: A disciplined defensive stance — counter for 2 turns and DEF +1 stage.

ambushGuardShort.name: Ambush Guard I
ambushGuardShort.desc: 🎯 Ready a close watch — the first enemy to move ADJACENT (1 tile) on the enemy turn eats a free reaction strike. Once per enemy turn; re-cast after it fires.

ambushGuardLong.name: Ambush Guard III
ambushGuardLong.desc: 🎯 Ready a long watch — the first enemy to move within 3 tiles on the enemy turn eats a free reaction strike. Once per enemy turn; re-cast after it fires.

grapplingHook.name: Grappling Hook
grapplingHook.desc: 🪝 Teleport up to 4 tiles to an empty space. Free action — does not consume your move. Pairs with high ground.

rainDance.name: Stormcaller's Chant
rainDance.desc: Sing the clouds down — a 🌧 Rainstorm rolls in for 4 turns. Water +50%, Fire -50%.

sunnyDay.name: Solar Hymn
sunnyDay.desc: Lift a hymn to the sun — the sky clears for 4 turns. Fire +50%, Water -50%.

sandstormCall.name: Dust Tempest
sandstormCall.desc: Stir the desert into fury — a 🏜 Dust Tempest scours all but Earth/Storm for 3 dmg/turn.

mistmaker.name: Veil of Fog
mistmaker.desc: Draw a thick 🌫 fog across the field for 4 turns. All attacks +25% miss.

eclipseRite.name: Eclipse Rite
eclipseRite.desc: Call a 🌑 Eclipse — Shadow +50%, Light -50% for 4 turns.

bloodmoonRite.name: Bloodmoon Rite
bloodmoonRite.desc: Summon the 🌕 Bloodmoon — attackers heal 20% of damage dealt for 4 turns.

mindWarp.name: Mind Warp
mindWarp.desc: Bend reality into the 🧠 Mind Realm — Magic +30%, status effects fail.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.desc: Provoke the target — they must attack the nearest enemy and can only use attack moves (+3 ATK / -2 DEF, 3 turns).

taunt.name: Goading Slight
taunt.desc: A cutting insult — the target locks into Rage (must attack the nearest enemy) for 2 turns.

outrage.name: Berserker's Frenzy
outrage.desc: A frenzied strike — 38 dmg. Locks YOU into Rage for 2 turns (can only attack closest enemy).

berserkerRoar.name: Berserker Roar
berserkerRoar.desc: Embrace the frenzy — +1 ATK stage and 3 turns of Rage (must attack the nearest enemy).

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.desc: Shatters the active field — destroys whichever Location is on the board.

dispelField.name: Dispel Field
dispelField.desc: Cheaper field-spell removal — costs 1⚡ but provides no other benefit.

severAwakening.name: Sever Awakening
severAwakening.desc: If target has Kalon Mode: revert their transformation (if active) and seal them — they can never awaken again this match. Only works on Kalon-capable units / heroes.

happyDance.name: Happy Dance
happyDance.desc: Target becomes Happy — cannot attack you for 3 turns (still attacks other allies normally).

cheerfulCharm.name: Cheerful Charm
cheerfulCharm.desc: Single-target Happy for 4 turns — longer melee version.

followMyLead.name: Follow My Lead
followMyLead.desc: Target can only move TOWARD you and cannot attack anyone for 2 turns.

pacifyingHymn.name: Pacifying Hymn
pacifyingHymn.desc: Stronger Follow My Lead — locks the target onto you for 3 turns.

xenobite.name: Xenobite
xenobite.desc: A parasitic bite — 70% chance to Infect for 3 turns.

sporeCloud.name: Spore Cloud
sporeCloud.desc: A guaranteed 4-turn Infection — no damage, but halves their stats hard.

bless.name: Sanctify
bless.desc: Pour divine favor on every ally — +3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES for 2 turns.

bane.name: Hex of Withering
bane.desc: Curse every enemy on the field — -3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES for 2 turns.

wish.name: Restoration
wish.desc: Channel a tide of pure life — restore 35 HP to one ally.

healingWord.name: Mending Whisper
healingWord.desc: A whispered prayer — free 10 HP heal at long range.

bellyDrum.name: Bloodfury Pact
bellyDrum.desc: Pay 50% of your current HP to enter a battle frenzy — +4 ATK for 4 turns.

substitute.name: Mirage Decoy
substitute.desc: Trade 25% HP for a shimmering decoy — fully immune to damage and status next turn cycle.

sneakAttack.name: Flanking Strike
sneakAttack.desc: A precise stab from the side — +50% damage when a friendly unit is adjacent to the target.

doomMove.name: Mortal Sentence
doomMove.desc: ⌛ Mark a target for death — they die when the 3-turn timer expires unless cleansed.

toxicMove.name: Necrotic Bloom
toxicMove.desc: ☢️ Plant a necrotic seed — damage RAMPS each turn (3, 6, 9, 12 HP).

mirrorImage.name: Phantom Veil
mirrorImage.desc: 🪞 Conjure illusory duplicates — 50% dodge chance for 2 turns.

reraiseMove.name: Soul Anchor
reraiseMove.desc: ✨ Tether an ally's soul to the living world — first KO within 5 turns revives them at 50% HP.

holdMonster.name: Binding Sigil
holdMonster.desc: 🪡 Inscribe a binding rune in the air — 90% chance to Stun the target for 2 turns.

tailwind.name: Stormwake
tailwind.desc: 🌬️ Summon a favorable gale — every ally gains Haste for 4 turns.

spectralHaze.name: Spectral Haze
spectralHaze.desc: 👻 Wreathe the target in haunted fog — for 3 turns EVERY attack it makes misses 100% of the time.

disperse.name: Disperse
disperse.desc: 🌤 Slash through the sky — instantly ends any active weather card. Cheap counter to weather-control decks.

disarmSweep.name: Disarm Sweep
disarmSweep.desc: 🪤 Sweep the dirt — disarms every enemy trap within 2 tiles. One of the few answers to a hand full of traps.

greatPurge.name: Great Purge
greatPurge.desc: ☀ Holy detonation — disarms EVERY enemy trap on the board (whole field). Expensive, but resets a trap-locked match.

reconPulse.name: Recon Pulse
reconPulse.desc: 🔍 Send out a ping — reveals every enemy trap on the board face-up for the rest of the match. Doesn't disarm; just lets you route around them.

wreckingSwing.name: Wrecking Swing
wreckingSwing.desc: 🧱 Mighty swing — destroys every enemy wall within 1 tile. The straightforward answer to wall-spam decks.

shatterStrike.name: Shatter Strike
shatterStrike.desc: 🧱💥 Devastating ground slam — destroys every enemy wall within 2 tiles. Crushes deep wall stacks in one cast.

cleansingStomp.name: Cleansing Stomp
cleansingStomp.desc: 🧹 Stomp the ground clean — wipes oil / fire / water / glass / mud within 1 tile. Walks your team through a surface stack safely.

purifyingRing.name: Purifying Ring
purifyingRing.desc: 🧹💧 Cascading wave — wipes every surface hazard within 3 tiles. Big AoE counter to surface-paint specialists.

scanShot.name: Scan Shot
scanShot.desc: 🔍 Pulse-mark one enemy at range 4 — instantly reveals their type, faction, element, passives, moves, and full stats. Stays scanned for the whole match.

reconWave.name: Recon Wave
reconWave.desc: 🔍 Send out a 3-tile recon wave — every enemy within is fully revealed for the rest of the match. Synergizes with weak-point comps.

totalSurveillance.name: Total Surveillance
totalSurveillance.desc: 🛰 Deploy a satellite ping — scans EVERY enemy unit + hero on the board. The ultimate intel move.

dualSlice.name: Dual Slice
dualSlice.desc: ⚔️⚔️ Two arcing blade swings delivered in one fluid motion. Always strikes exactly twice — each hit rolls crits independently.

doubleKick.name: Double Kick
doubleKick.desc: 🦵🦵 A swift two-kick combo that never misses. Guaranteed 2 hits — great for reliable chip damage.

twinStrike.name: Twin Strike
twinStrike.desc: ⚡⚡ Two rapid strikes at mid-range, both rolls fully independent. Higher crit chance than Dual Slice.

furySwipes.name: Fury Swipes
furySwipes.desc: 🐾 Relentless clawing frenzy — 2 to 5 hits per use, each rolled independently. Low power per claw, but 5-hit rolls are brutal.

bulletSeed.name: Bullet Seed
bulletSeed.desc: 🌱💥 Fires 2 to 5 nature seeds at range 3. Never misses — each seed deals damage independently.

pinMissile.name: Pin Missile
pinMissile.desc: 📌 A volley of razor-sharp needles fired at long range — 2 to 5 hits. Each spike rolls crits independently.

doubleDragon.name: Double Dragon
doubleDragon.desc: 🐉🐉 Conjure twin dragon maws that snap twice in sequence. Both hits are magical; each can crit. Best magic dual-hit in the catalog.

rockBlast.name: Rock Blast
rockBlast.desc: 🪨 Hurls 2 to 5 jagged boulders in rapid succession. Breaks through barriers — each boulder is an independent earth hit.
